title: The Cold-Start Tax: Warm-Up, Re-Warm, and Residency Policy for Duty-Cycled Edge DNN Inference
description: Artifact for The Cold-Start Tax: Warm-Up, Re-Warm, and Residency Policy for Duty-Cycled Edge DNN Inference (under review). Hardware measurements on a Raspberry Pi 5 (Arm Cortex-A76) of the latency and PMIC energy transient at every wake of a duty-cycled device, its decomposition, the page-cache eviction effect that re-triggers it, and a residency policy built from the measurements.
